info.title: API.SH: Tractor Supply
info.description: The Tractor Supply API from API.SH: public Tractor Supply data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Tractor Supply's departments, or the subcategories (with their own subcategories) of one department: code (pass it back here), name, link and image.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tractorsupply-categories

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category `code` from this route (optional; default the departments).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tractorsupply-product

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: ZIP code for the nearest store's price.

get.description:
Search Tractor Supply's catalog by keywords with brand and any catalog facet (price band, rating, availability, autoship, same-day delivery, pickup, product attributes) through `filter`. Each product: part number, name, link, brand, the price at a store (the store nearest `zip`, else a default store), list price and savings, see-price-in-cart flag, rating, review count, availability (online only, in stores), pickup and truck-delivery flags, image, short description, manufacturer part number and variant count, catalog listing ids (`category_ids`, for /tractorsupply/v1/category), plus `raw`. Also returns the facets with counts and the `filter` value of each option. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tractorsupply-search

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand as the catalog spells it, e.g. DEWALT (comma list).

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Facet filters: the `filter` value of an option in `facets`, e.g. ads_f43659_ntk_cs:"Cordless" (several separated by ;).

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: 5-digit ZIP code: prices of the nearest store.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Stock of a Tractor Supply product at the stores near a ZIP code: per store and variant the stock status, quantity available for store pickup, incoming quantity, quantity available to ship and for same-day delivery, with the store's details.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tractorsupply-stock

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Grandpa's Feeders 20 lb. The Original and Genuine Automatic Chicken Feeder, Standard

skus.name: Grandpa's Feeders 20 lb. The Original and Genuine Automatic Chicken Feeder, Standard

get.description:
Tractor Supply stores near a ZIP code, nearest first: store number, name, address, phone, coordinates, distance in miles, time zone, opening hours by day, today's hours, services (propane refill, trailer rental, pet wash, vet clinic, same-day delivery, ...) and pickup flags. Filter by one service.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tractorsupply-stores

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: Only stores offering this service, e.g. PROPANE TANK REFILL (values in `services`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
